div.head: Ine 76
div.ab: CXX. Gif hwa oðres godsunu slea oððe his godfæder, sie sio mægbot ⁊ sio manbot gelíc; weaxe sio bot be ðam were, swa ilce swa sio manbot deð þe þam hlaforde sceal.
Gif hwa oþres godsunu slea.., ..sio mægbot ⁊ sio manbot ...; ..m were, swa ilce swa sio .... ::aforde sceal.
CXX. Gif hwa oþres godsunu slea oððe his godfæder, sy seo mægbot ⁊ seo monbot gelic; weaxe seo bot be þam were, swa ilce swa seo monbot deþ þe ðam hlaforde sceal.
Be godfæderes oððe godsunes slæhte. Gyf hwá oðres godsunu sléa oððe his godfæder, sy seo mægbot ⁊ séo manbot gelic; weaxe seo bot be ðam were, swa ilce swa seo manbót deð þe ðam hlaforde sceal.
Si quis alterius filiolum occidat uel patrinum, sit simile cognationi; et crescat emendatio secundum weram (eius), sicut manbota facit erga dominum.
[Be godfæderes oððe godsunes slæhte.] Gif hwa oðres godsunu slea oððe his godfæder, sie sio mægbot ⁊ sio manbot gelíc; weaxe sio bot be ðam were, swa ilce swa sio manbot deð þe þam hlaforde sceal.
{CXX} Gif hwa oðres godsunu slea oððe his godfæder, sie sio mægbot ⁊ sio manbot gelic; weaxe sio bot be ðam were, swa ilce swa sio monbot deð þe þam hlaforde sceal.

Wenn jemand den Taufsohn eines anderen oder dessen Taufvater erschlägt, so sei die Busse für diesen [geistlichen] Verwandten gleich [hoch] wie Mannbusse; es wachse jene Busse gemäss dem Wergelde [des Erschlagenen], ebenso wie [das] die dem Herrn [desselben] gebührende Mannbusse thut.

If someone slays another’s godson or his godfather, let the compensation for this [spiritual] kinsman be equal [in amount] to the man-compensation; let that compensation grow according to the wergeld [of the slain man], just as the man-compensation due to his lord does.

If anyone slays the godson or the godfather of another, the sum to be paid as compensation to a man who has entered into a relationship of this kind shall be equal to the amount paid to the dead man's lord. The amount of compensation shall increase according to the wergeld, just as is the case with compensation due to a man's lord.

If anyone kills the godson or godfather of another, the compensation for the [spiritual] relationship is to be the same as that to the lord; the compensation is to increase in proportion to the wergild, the same as the compensation for his man does which has to be paid to the lord.

If someone slays another person’s godson or his godfather, let the man-price [paid] to the [religious] kinsman be equal [to that paid] to the lord; the price [paid the kinsman] shall increase according to the wer, just as does the man-price owed to the lord.

Dies hat Hn 79, 1—c benutzt, wieder nur z. T. aus Q, z. T. aus dem Agsä. — Dieses letzte Kapitel ist, wie der Beginn von Ine, kirchlich: vielleicht ein Nachsatz, von anderem Geiste oder Anlass eingegeben

Hn 79, 1—c has used this, again only partly from Q, partly from the Anglo-Saxon. — This last chapter, like the beginning of Ine, is ecclesiastical: perhaps an afterthought, prompted by a different spirit or occasion

Vgl. Taufverwandte 3. — Geistliche Verwandtschaft erwies sich stärker denn Rachepflicht; Graf Osric schont unter den Mördern seines Königs Cynewulf von Wessex nur seinen eigenen godsunu; Ann. Anglosax. 784 = filius de baptismo; Ethelwerd. — Über den cumpæder (Gevatter) in Urkk. und Sprache vgl. Earle Two Saxon. chron. p. 318

Cf. Taufverwandte 3. — Spiritual kinship proved stronger than the duty of vengeance; Earl Osric, among the murderers of his king Cynewulf of Wessex, spares only his own godsunu; Ann. Anglosax. 784 = filius de baptismo; Ethelwerd. — On the cumpæder (godfather) in charters and in the language cf. Earle Two Saxon. chron. p. 318
So Wilda 337. Mægbot fällt hier an Gevatter oder Paten (ändere so im Wb), sonst an natürliche Sippe (ebd.)
So Wilda 337. Mægbot falls here to the godfather or the godchild (correct the Wb accordingly), elsewhere to the natural kindred (ibid.)
Durch eine Auslassung scheint Q noch kirchlicher die Busse für geistliche der für natürliche Verwandtschaft gleich hoch zu stellen
Through an omission Q seems, still more ecclesiastically, to set the compensation for spiritual kinship as high as that for natural kinship
Ich verstehe: man erhält für erschlagenen Gevatter oder Patenkind 30 (80, 120) Schill. mægbot, wenn er 200 (600, 1200) Schill. Wergeld hatte, wie Mannbusse (s. d. Gl 15. 17) nach 70
I understand it thus: for a slain godfather or godchild one receives 30 (80, 120) shill. mægbot, if he had 200 (600, 1200) shill. wergild, like manbot (see that word in Gl 15. 17) according to 70

For the importance attached to this form of relationship cf. Sax. Chron. ann. 755, where a solitary survivor of the defeated force is excused for his surrender, on the ground that he was the godson of the leader of the victorious party.
For manbot see note to cap. 70 above.
